narrationDirection: Perform this original Thai romantic comedy as a native Bangkok Thai man telling a friend an embarrassing true story, half laughing at himself. Same warm male narrator throughout. Brisk, connected conversational phrasing with varied stress; never the same rise and fall on each phrase. Open with a quick jolt of panic. On the name Praew drop to a small, stunned beat. The awkward silence and the emergency button are dry and funny. When the story cuts to the lobby, lean in conspiratorially, the listener knows something the couple does not. The bickering is light and petty, not angry. The final question is quiet and sincere, then the choice is asked directly to the viewer. Natural thought-group breaths, no long gaps. Read only the provided Thai text; do not speak these instructions or bracketed delivery tags.
